evidence.Workflow / Use Case: Financing and securing power and data-center capacity for OpenAI AI workloads
evidence.Claim / Evidence Summary: Nvidia agreed to invest $1.5 billion in SoftBank-backed SB Energy and secure up to 8 GW of AI computing capacity at an Ohio campus being developed for OpenAI; the campus initially targets 4.25 GW.
evidence.Likely Value Capturer: Nvidia; SB Energy; OpenAI; power and infrastructure suppliers
evidence.Constraint / Bottleneck: Power generation; grid infrastructure; construction; financing; circular-financing scrutiny
evidence.Source Title: Nvidia to invest $1.5 billion in SB Energy under OpenAI data center deal
evidence.Supporting Excerpt (≤20 words): Nvidia will invest $1.5 billion in SoftBank-backed SB Energy and secure up to 8 gigawatts of AI computing capacity
evidence.Notes: Records a signed investment/capacity deal, not deployed capacity or realized OpenAI compute. SB Energy and SoftBank separately plan at least 10 GW of new power and $4.2 billion of Ohio grid investment; those figures are not treated as completed infrastructure.
